npc.ship_bartender.short_description: Keeps Jomon's common room and knows which regional casks travel safely.
npc.ship_bartender.initial_memory: Sena took the bar on witnessed household shares.

npc.ship_merchant.short_description: A coast-and-river factor who visits Jomon only when a recorded route cycle and regional stock justify the mooring.
npc.ship_merchant.initial_memory: Veyra first heard Jomon's name in four working markets.
npc.ship_merchant.build_tendency: bounded tools, witnessed exchange, and regional shortages

household.character_creation_background: A {ancestry} adult raised in {origin}; now Jomon's {role_label}.

context_0.condition: Long rain has swollen the river and drowned the mill path.
context_0.work: Hearthford keeps a grain mill beside a flood-damaged race.
context_0.pressure: The mill needs ironwork before its gate tears loose.
context_0.objective: Recover two cases of iron fittings from the stranded wheelhouse cart.

context_1.condition: A salt surge has warped sheds along the lower river edge.
context_1.work: Hearthford cures fish and repairs coast-bound cargo boats.
context_1.pressure: The smokehouse needs timber braces before the next tide.
context_1.objective: Recover two timber braces from the stranded wheelhouse cart.

context_2.condition: Cold fog has delayed fuel barges and left the forges idle.
context_2.work: Hearthford's smiths maintain mill gear and river tools.
context_2.pressure: The smithy needs charcoal while the safe towpath is closed.
context_2.objective: Recover two dry charcoal sacks from the stranded wheelhouse cart.

recruit-maelin.name: Maelin Rook
recruit-maelin.background: A salt-runner who reads firm ground from draining ripples.
recruit-maelin.build_tendency: light armour, tide routes, and thrown weapons
recruit-maelin.terms: Help the coast saltworks or offer two accountable credits.
recruit-maelin.memory: Jomon once carried medicine through a closing tidal channel.

recruit-jessa.name: Jessa Flint
recruit-jessa.background: A wreck-diver who knots weighted nets for surf and deck work.
recruit-jessa.build_tendency: nets, cargo recovery, and close control
recruit-jessa.terms: Recover a named wreck locker without abandoning its owner.
recruit-jessa.memory: She will not call recovered property salvage while its keeper lives.

recruit-orra.name: Orra Fen
recruit-orra.background: A burner-watch who follows smoke, disturbed birds, and crosswind sound.
recruit-orra.build_tendency: stealth, smoke, bows, and open woodland routes
recruit-orra.terms: Keep the forest burn from spreading into the medicine stands.
recruit-orra.memory: Orra remembers which crews listened before entering the burnwood.

recruit-bran.name: Bran Wold
recruit-bran.background: A travelling adult healer who trades resin dressings for safe passage.
recruit-bran.build_tendency: injury control, thorns, and patient expeditions
recruit-bran.terms: Bring the wounded charcoal reeve home or settle their care.
recruit-bran.memory: Bran judges households by how they return with wounded companions.

recruit-teren.name: Teren Chalk
recruit-teren.background: A face-worker who knows limestone fractures and suspended loads.
recruit-teren.build_tendency: heavy tools, climbing, and breakable terrain
recruit-teren.terms: Stabilise the quarry bridge or prove a safer route around it.
recruit-teren.memory: Teren left a crew that treated preventable rockfall as fate.

recruit-sava.name: Sava Bell
recruit-sava.background: A shepherd-ward who uses sling arcs beyond cliff-edge cover.
recruit-sava.build_tendency: sling fire, height, light loads, and lookout control
recruit-sava.terms: Break the false toll alarm without harming the upland carriers.
recruit-sava.memory: Sava remembers every warning bell rung for private profit.
